clips.title: The story
paras: Deep beneath the cobblestones of Stormwind, the high-security Stockade has fallen into total chaos. Following a coordinated breakout led by incarcerated members of the Defias Brotherhood, Warden Thelwater is urgently commissioning adventurers to cut down the rioting inmates and restore order before the capital learns how compromised the facility truly is.

The Stockade was built to contain the most dangerous criminals, conspirators, and outlaws threatening the Kingdom of Stormwind. However, a sudden, violent uprising orchestrated by imprisoned Defias operatives has wrested control of the cell blocks directly from the guards. With the prison thoroughly overrun and corridors choked with armed felons, normal protocol has collapsed entirely. Rather than mounting a structured retaking, prison authorities are relying on visiting champions to fight their way through the riots.

Warden Thelwater's command to execute Defias prisoners on sight reflects both sheer desperation and an effort of self-preservation. Suspecting foul play behind the coordinated mutiny, the warden fears that if the broader nobility or the House of Nobles discovers the facility is out of hand, his post will be forfeit. By decreeing death as the immediate penalty for insurgency, Thelwater hopes brute force will break the inmates' spirits and quell the rebellion before word leaks past the canal gates.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The uprising must be quelled! I need your assistance. If word gets out that the prison is overrun I will lose my job! This is a case of foul play if I've ever seen one. But what's important now is forcing these prisoners into submission for the safety of Stormwind.
The punishment for insurgency is death. Kill some of these deviants! That ought to get things under control.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Stockade is still overrun! These Defias Rats must be shown that their actions will not be tolerated. Now get back down there and show some force!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your efforts in The Stockade were valiant, friend. It's obvious this problem is bigger than the both of us. But you have performed well and for that I am thankful.
